text:
sam: hey everyone! first day here :wave: finished laptop image. hitting a few provisioning snags: Okta login worked but no apps listed, GSuite doesn't show my team drive, 1Password invite link errors with "invalid token", and trying to register my YubiKey gives "Registration failed". who should I ping?
it-support: welcome sam! can you confirm you used your @redwood.com account and not a personal email? also which browser and OS are you on?
sam: yes company email. MacBook Monterey, Chrome 115. browser shows okta dashboard but apps grid is empty. Drive shows only an empty "My Drive". 1Password email received but link errors.
idp-bot: New hire provisioning normally completes within 10 minutes but can be delayed by SCIM jobs. If delay >30m, tag @it-support and @maria (identity). See onboarding docs: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/setup :book:
maria: tagging in. i see a SCIM failure for user sam@redwood.com at 02:18 UTC citing "group mapping mismatch". likely groupsync didn't attach eng-team groups so apps/GDrive ACLs didn't propagate. i'll trigger a manual resync.
it-support: while maria works on SCIM, try incognito to rule out cached session. for 1Password we'll resend invite after resync. if YubiKey fails, can you paste the exact modal text?
sam: incognito same. YubiKey modal: "Registration failed: unable to verify device". tried with touch locked on.
cto: @maria fyi, new joiner just in. could this be the same groupsync race we fixed yesterday?
maria: possible. i kicked the resync and it completed at 02:25 UTC with success for eng-team membership. will re-provision apps now.
it-support: re-sent 1Password invite to sam@redwood.com (new token) and manually added sam to the Drive folder ACL so you should be able to open the team folder shortly.
sam: got 1Password, link works now :tada: Drive folder still says "Request access" for a moment then opened after refresh. thanks. YubiKey still failing though.
it-support: for the YubiKey try these steps: 1) toggle Chrome flags for WebAuthn? No, better: ensure Chrome has access to USB devices (System Preferences -> Security & Privacy), reboot, try again. also try registering via Safari if Chrome fails. if still failing, bring device to IT and we'll test with another machine or issue replacement.
sam: trying Safari now. same error. I also tried on my personal laptop and it registered fine there. so maybe company laptop USB drivers?
it-support: hmm if it works on personal device but not company laptop, please open a ticket with device serial and we'll swap the USB adapter or reimage. as a temporary MFA option, we can enable Okta Verify (push) on your phone.
sam: ok enabling Okta Verify now, that worked. thanks everyone.
maria: root cause: SCIM groupsync failed due to a mapping change in the YAML config; i've reverted the change and re-ran the job. follow-up: i'll add a small delay in the onboarding pipeline to prevent race with initial app assignment.
cto: thanks for the quick turnaround. sam, welcome aboard! ping me if you want a quick tour later today. :coffee:
it-support: closing loop: resync fixed apps and GDrive ACL, 1Password reissued, YubiKey hardware/USB issue isolated to machine, temp Okta Verify enabled. next steps: sam to file hardware swap ticket if they want YubiKey on company laptop. :white_check_mark:
